post.title: LEFT on a date cell gives 46 instead of the month
post.description:
left function on a date returns the serial number instead of the month
A date cell holds a serial number, so LEFT slices the serial and not the date you see. Wrap it in TEXT first, using a date code that matches your regional settings. Save this for close.
